Title: The Cognitive Search feature of Azure Search is now available

Body.Content:
Cognitive Search is an enrichment pipeline that transforms raw, unstructured content into rich searchable information in an Azure Search index.

  • Find structured information from unstructured data
  • Powered by cognitive skills, such as natural language processing and computer vision capabilities
  • Extracts structure and semantics from unstructured and non-textual data, and feeds it into a search index

Learn more
